videos.title: Why 94% of China Lives East of This Line
videos.description: An investigation into China's demographic distribution, the Heihe-Tengchong line, geographic barriers, agricultural viability, and population pressure shifts.

videos.title: Climate change: Earth's giant game of Tetris
videos.description: A spatial analysis of climate vulnerability, rising sea levels, changing biome distributions, climate migration corridors, and international adaptation strategies.

videos.title: Population & Food: Crash Course Geography #16
videos.description: An overview of ecological footprints, global resource distribution, Malthusian vs. Boserupian models of population growth, and resource security challenges.

videos.title: Meet the enormous boats that carry your stuff
videos.description: Exploring the spatial interactions, logistics networks, global shipping lanes, key maritime chokepoints (Suez, Panama, Malacca), and structural supply chain vulnerabilities.

videos.title: 200 Years, 200 Countries, 4 Minutes
videos.description: Analyzing global development indices, GNI per capita, human development metrics, multidimensional poverty, and institutional structural aid in low-income nations.

videos.title: We WILL Fix Climate Change!
videos.description: An in-depth case study of environmental degradation, community resilience, risk management, and the forced relocation of indigenous populations due to coastal erosion.

videos.title: Where we get our fresh water
videos.description: An exploration of Earth's water distribution, freshwater storage systems, and the hydrological systems that supply human civilization.

videos.title: What Happens if a Supervolcano Blows Up?
videos.description: Examining volcanic hazard maps, seismic anomalies, gas emissions, deformation monitoring, and disaster mitigation strategies for active geophysical hazards.

videos.title: The Cruise Industry's Arms Race
videos.description: Analyzing the globalization of leisure, tourism nodes, carrying capacity of small island tourist economies, and the environmental footprint of cruise terminals.
